Title: Recreating the Lasombra's Deck Bashing Challenge Archive

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:

What are the bashing decks about?

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
They were the various entries for Atom Weaver's Deck Bashing Challenge

The original challenge was

The VTES Precon Decklist Bashing Challenge 03.01.07

Using only the cards contained in two precon starters
of your choice, generate a decklist you think would be
competitive in a mid-size constructed tournament (not a
qualifier or championship, but assume strong local players,
and, say 20 participants). Duplicating a starter is
acceptable. Choosing more recent precons (3rd Ed, LOB,
KMW) is preferred (but not mandatory). Alternatively,
you could choose to substitute the content of VTES Player's
Kit for one precon. If you've got the stones to play it
For Real in a sanctioned event, so much the better, let
us know how you do.

The goals here are

1) to challenge your m@dd deckbuilding skills!!

2) to generate some ideas for competitive decks that
new/early players might look to for inspiration and
direction for their own collecting efforts.

Also, I think these decklists could go a long way as
evidence against the (false) perceived need for big
investment in cards in order to build competitive decks.

Regards,
Dave Zopf
Atom Weaver
